name: explicit hours no longer skips the gap query, so a caller with a no-order_by stub DB crashes
the gap-since-last-review computation is dropped, so the window never grows past the cap default
the lookback cap is removed, so a year-old gap is scanned in full instead of bounded
pagination stops after the first page, so a wide window truncates at 200 messages again
the page cap is removed, so a pathological cursor chain loops beyond bounds unnoticed
not-configured is no longer distinguished from a history-read failure, so the caller cannot pick the right HTTP status
a poll cycle that queued new reviews is never actually enqueued as jobs
the fixed 72h window comes back on the refresh button, reintroducing the permanent blind spot
